messages:
Ravi - Alliances: quick thread to lock rules for BlueWave co-sell on Borealis Corp. Need final decision on credit splits, crm mapping, and embargo for the joint announcement.
Tess - GTM Ops: can we also clarify duplicate-account flows? Borealis has an existing pilot record from last year.
Mateo (BlueWave SI): from our side: introduced vs joint? also POC funding changes expectations.
Ravi - Alliances: draft proposal: introduced = 35% first-year booking credit; joint (AE+SI active) = 15%; SI-funded POC = 45% plus services credit. If SI is primary technical owner of POC, mark role = "poc_lead".
Priya - Sales Eng: edge-case: if AE discovers account in our CRM but SI submitted opportunity first via portal, what wins?
Tess - GTM Ops: rule: portal submission timestamp wins for intro if before AE outreach. If AE outreach exists and portal submission after, route to co-sell-review.
Kara - Finance: we need a clean provenance field so commissions split automatically. Add: si_partner_id, si_credit_band, si_credit_locked_at_stage. Credit locked when stage == "Closed Won" (contract inked).
Ravi - Alliances: good. CRM mapping pseudo-code to keep ops teams aligned:
```
match = find_account_by_domain(prospect.email)
if match and match.owner != si.owner:
  create_subopp(type="si_collab", partner=si.id)
  queue = "co-sell-review"
elif portal.submission and portal.timestamp < ae.first_contact:
  mark_role = "introduced"
else:
  mark_role = "joint"
```
Mateo (BlueWave SI): acceptable. Also need a clear "claim window" — if SI submits intro and AE doesn't act in 7 days, commit to outreach or release claim.
Tess - GTM Ops: agree: 7d action window for AE ack, 48h for SI to accept after intake. Automations will timestamp everything.
Priya - Sales Eng: technical handoffs: when SI is poc_lead, require a shared runbook (confluence) with test-data and acceptance criteria. This must be created within 3 business days of SI ack.
Kara - Finance: marketplace + co-marketing funds: if SI funds POC we will apply a one-time co-marketing credit equal to 5% of the POC services invoice to marketing spend. Need PO number recorded on opp (si_po_number).
Ravi - Alliances: announcement embargo: joint public mentions require 10 business days written notice and legal signoff. For cloud marketplace listing we need a 5-business-day review with marketing and compliance.
Tess - GTM Ops: PartnerBot automation list: 1) on tag #si-handshake create partner intake ticket; 2) capture portal timestamp, SI submit timestamp, AE outreach timestamp; 3) if match by domain auto-create subopp; 4) ping #partner-ops on missing ack.
PartnerBot: auto: created partner-intake ticket PT-49231 for Borealis / BlueWave. Captured timestamps and queued for co-sell-review.
Kara - Finance: also require partner_credit_pct numeric on opp and partner_credit_reason (introduced|joint|poc_funded). Finance will reject splits not populated at Closed Won.
Mateo (BlueWave SI): one more ask: can we flag accounts with export/regulatory constraints so we can decide on private deployment handoffs?
Ravi - Alliances: add flag account.restricted = true/false; restricted accounts require legal & security signoff before SI engagement.
Tess - GTM Ops: final action items:
- Mateo: ack PT-49231 and upload POC scope (due EOD +2).
- Priya: create POC runbook template in Confluence and link in ticket.
- Kara: add new opp fields (si_partner_id, si_credit_band, si_credit_locked_at_stage, si_po_number, partner_credit_pct, partner_credit_reason).
- Platform: implement sub-opportunity flow per pseudo-code and expose timestamps to PartnerBot webhook.
- Marketing: prepare marketplace blurb template (1-paragraph tech + 1-paragraph value) and co-branded logo spec; legal review timeline 5bd.
Ravi - Alliances: will capture in the SI playbook and send a lightweight PRD. Thanks all.
Mateo (BlueWave SI): thanks team, will ack and upload scope.
PartnerBot: auto: PT-49231 updated by Mateo (BlueWave SI) — POC scope uploaded.
